liiga.method: one hockey fill factor, fitted by mean absolute percentage error; it replaces the prior only when its leave-one-out MAPE is lower; the published error is leave-one-out

venue_collisions.method: same venue + date + published start: cap combined mid at the smallest applicable venue capacity and allocate proportionally; flag every shared group as an unresolved room split
venue_collisions.note: TBA rows have no single published start and are not grouped. A published maxParticipants is a per-event cap, not evidence of which room a listing uses.

tba_start.method: unknown starts are averaged uniformly over 18:00, 19:00 and 20:00; arrival and egress curves are mixed instead of pinned to one peak
tba_start.note: The feed published no start; the row keeps its empty time and the UI says TBA. This is a documented uncertainty window, not a measured start.

competition.method: shared-catchment demand pool: require >=50% top-zone overlap and an overlapping active window; count the shared slice once at the largest exposed event and apportion it by exposure; floor 0.05
competition.note: Not fitted or measured: a prior for sharing demand between concurrent events. Only top-zone shares are compared; the unlisted remainder is not assumed to overlap. Unique catchment slices are retained, so a smaller event is not erased by a larger peer.

city_capacity.note: maxParticipants is a published cap, not realized attendance; it is never used as backtest ground truth.

source_note: Music from tampere-keikat (read-only), hockey fixtures from the Liiga game list, student events from Kide, stage/culture/community events from the Tampere city calendar. Every row comes from a published feed; the SAMPLE seed file is only used with --with-samples.
